install:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y maven docker.io
sudo service docker start || sudo systemctl start docker || true
cd /workspace/server && make setup INPUT_DIR=tests/fixtures/proves && make prepare INPUT_DIR=tests/fixtures/proves
cd /workspace/client && make setup
start: cd /workspace/server && docker compose up -d yamcs && .venv/bin/python -c "from proves_yamcs.supervisor import wait_until_ready; wait_until_ready('http://127.0.0.1:8090', 'fprime-project', 180)"
